changes: Add generic admitted column-name collection with deduplication and optional ordering.
Deferred top-k rank and output column lists use the same scoped collector rather than untracked Set/spread/map allocations.
Allow expression column traversal to target a narrow add interface, so admitted collection does not duplicate expression traversal.
Keep planning ownership in a child scope excluded from returned owned results.

scenarios: Exact measured peak and one-byte-below rejection with and without sorting.
Unicode names, duplicate expression references and prototype-like names.
Allocation and traversal failures release partial planner storage while preserving sibling ownership.
Existing borrowed/owned deferred top-k boundary and query semantics tests.

remaining: Earlier query-builder configuration and order-term normalization are not covered by this planning helper.
Other query planners and expression/runtime traversal workspace still require allocation review.
No total Worker heap claim or new performance-speedup claim.
